[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] '''Aziel''' was a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served under the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|vigo]] [[Qazadi]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Aziel accompanied Qazadi on a trip to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]] on a mission to inspect the blackmail files of Black Sun leader [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], which were held on the world by [[Black Sun sector chief|Black Sun Sector Chief]] [[Avrak Villachor]]. During the visit, Aziel stayed in a suite at the luxury [[Lulina Crown Hotel]] in [[Iltarr City]], where he held custody of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] last remaining [[cryodex]], an encryption device that could be used to read Xizor's files. Aziel was later arrested by Imperial forces dispatched from the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Dominator (Imperial-class)|''Dominator'']], though the Imperials were ultimately forced to let him go.<ref name="Scoundrels" />
